# Qingye UI 5.2.0

> Facts for @qingye_lab/ui@5.2.0. Runtime acceptance is separate.

## Start
- [Design guide](../../../design.en.md)
- [Style contract](../../style.en.md): bans, observable criteria and component implementation rules
- [Design philosophy](../../design-philosophy.en.md): method sources
- [Installation](../installation.md)
- [Main skill](../../SKILL.en.md)

## Components
- [Accordion](components/accordion.md): Reveal content from each item's named trigger.
- [Alert](components/alert.md): Static local information, with announcements only when requested.
- [AlertDialog](components/alert-dialog.md): Block the work surface for an explicit decision about the current object.
- [AsyncContent](components/async-content.md): Present request status separately from content that remains valid.
- [Autocomplete](components/autocomplete.md): Edit free text with optional suggestions.
- [Avatar](components/avatar.md): An image with one named identity and a fallback.
- [AvatarGroup](components/avatar-group.md): A set of related people, overlapped, with the surplus collapsed.
- [Badge](components/badge.md): A short marker that keeps its content name without inferring state.
- [Breadcrumb](components/breadcrumb.md): Parent links and an explicit current location.
- [BulkActionBar](components/bulk-action-bar.md): Shared actions with explicit targets, versions and scope.
- [Button](components/button.md): Trigger a named action with a clear object and consequence. The caller owns its state.
- [ButtonGroup](components/button-group.md): Give actions in one scope a shared name, spaced apart or attached into one body.
- [Calendar](components/calendar.md): Navigate a local calendar and select a day, multiple dates, or a range.
- [Card](components/card.md): Bound an independently identifiable object.
- [Cascader](components/cascader.md): Choose one value along a root-to-leaf path, or check several paths, with each level's candidates in its own column.
- [Chart](components/chart.md): Nine task-chosen forms—line, bar, area, area-stacked, area-share, bar-horizontal, bar-stacked, bar-share and donut—with a same-source plot, named axes and an on-demand data table.
- [Checkbox](components/checkbox.md): Choose an independent yes/no value or multiple items in a set.
- [CheckboxGroup](components/checkbox-group.md): Connect checkboxes to one collection and shared scope.
- [Chip](components/chip.md): A small mark that can be acted on by itself: removable, or toggleable.
- [CodeBlock](components/code-block.md): Literal text with an optional title bar and actual copy results.
- [Collapsible](components/collapsible.md): Reveal additional content for the same object.
- [ColorPicker](components/color-picker.md): Choose a colour that belongs to the user's data, such as a label colour or a theme setting, and get a #rrggbb string.
- [Combobox](components/combobox.md): Filter candidates and confirm one value or a set, with query text separate from selection.
- [Command](components/command.md): A search box over an always-open list of commands, for jumping somewhere or doing something.
- [Composer](components/composer.md): Multi-line input with @ mentions, / commands and atomic tokens; its value is an array of text and token segments.
- [Confirm](components/confirm.md): Await one explicit decision, then let the caller continue.
- [ConfirmAction](components/confirm-action.md): Confirm a specific object, version, and change; review again when content changes.
- [ContextMenu](components/context-menu.md): A context-menu enhancement for commands on the current object.
- [Copy button](components/copy-button.md): Copy supplied text and reflect the clipboard write result.
- [CornerMark](components/corner-mark.md): A count or presence dot anchored to a host's corner, never part of the host's own content.
- [DataTable](components/data-table.md): Comparison, sorting, scoped selection and optional virtualization for a caller-owned collection.
- [DatePicker](components/date-picker.md): Edit one local date or choose it from a calendar.
- [DateRangePicker](components/date-range-picker.md): Type or pick start and end dates; only a complete, ordered range is a confirmed value.
- [DateTimePicker](components/date-time-picker.md): Edit complete local wall-clock date/time, or apply calendar and time drafts.
- [DateTimeRangePicker](components/date-time-range-picker.md): Type or pick a start and an end date and time; only a complete, ordered range is a confirmed value.
- [DescriptionList](components/description-list.md): Native relationships between names and values.
- [Dialog](components/dialog.md): Take over the work surface for an edit or decision, then return.
- [Drawer](components/drawer.md): Enter an edge-aligned work surface and return to its entry point.
- [Empty](components/empty.md): Distinguish zero results, unknown and not applicable.
- [Field](components/field.md): Connect one value's name, control, description, and caller-supplied errors.
- [Fieldset](components/fieldset.md): Give related fields a shared name and disabled scope.
- [FileTrigger](components/file-trigger.md): Press a button to choose files and hand them to the application at once, retaining no selection.
- [FileUpload](components/file-upload.md): Choose or drop local files, retaining accepted files and real rejection reasons.
- [FilterBar](components/filter-bar.md): Shows draft conditions separately from applied facts.
- [Form](components/form.md): A native field submission scope and reset context.
- [Heatmap](components/heatmap.md): A quantity over two categorical dimensions, such as sync activity by weekday and hour; a single-hue sequential scale (the first series color, light to full) or application-declared levels, readable cell by cell from the keyboard, with an on-demand data table.
- [HoverCard](components/hover-card.md): Reveal the same supplemental content on hover and keyboard focus.
- [ImagePreview](components/image-preview.md): Thumbnails open a large view with switching within the set and zoom.
- [Input](components/input.md): Enter one text value.
- [InputGroup](components/input-group.md): Give an input and its markers, units or actions one editing boundary.
- [InputModalityProvider](components/input-modality-provider.md): Record input modality at the application root and skip transitions for keyboard input.
- [Item](components/item.md): Content, navigation and related actions.
- [Kbd](components/kbd.md): A native keyboard key display.
- [Label](components/label.md): Name one control with a native label.
- [Layout](components/layout.md): Arrange content vertically, side by side or in equal columns using pair, field, action, panel and section spacing roles.
- [Link](components/link.md): A text entry that goes to an address; every text link in the library shares this one treatment.
- [Locale switch](components/locale-switch.md): Request an application locale change and show the current Provider value.
- [Menu](components/menu.md): Temporary commands and choices related to the current task.
- [Meter](components/meter.md): A real measurement over a valid range.
- [NativeSelect](components/native-select.md): Keep the platform picker, native options and form values.
- [NavigationMenu](components/navigation-menu.md): Real links, expandable navigation groups, and in-panel group names with descriptions.
- [NumberField](components/number-field.md): Edit an optional number and adjust it by a declared step.
- [OtpField](components/otp-field.md): Present a fixed-length text value in segments.
- [PageHeader](components/page-header.md): Co-locate a page name, context and related actions.
- [Pagination](components/pagination.md): Page position, real actions and explicit unknown totals.
- [PasswordInput](components/password-input.md): Enter a password and switch to plain text to check it.
- [PendingValue](components/pending-value.md): An unresolved write result with its original value.
- [Popover](components/popover.md): A trigger-bound non-modal popup for local actions and supplementary information.
- [Progress](components/progress.md): Confirmed task completion or an explicit indeterminate state.
- [Proportion](components/proportion.md): Which parts make up a whole and how much each takes.
- [Prose](components/prose.md): Typesets already-rendered Markdown or rich text: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code and tables read existing text tiers and ink roles. It only typesets by default, with no frame; give it a reading paper with framed when the article stands alone with no surface of its own.
- [RadioGroup](components/radio-group.md): Choose one value from a small set of visible options.
- [Rating](components/rating.md): Give an integer score from 1 to max, shown as a row of stars.
- [Resizable](components/resizable.md): Draggable separators between two or more panels that change how the space is shared.
- [Result](components/result.md): The outcome of one action: a mark, a title, an explanation and where to go next.
- [ScatterChart](components/scatter-chart.md): The relationship between two numeric quantities; an all-pairs form with one to three series, a same-source scatter plot, named axes and an on-demand data table.
- [Scroll area](components/scroll-area.md): Native scrolling with an optional composition of draggable scrollbars.
- [SearchInput](components/search-input.md): Enter a search term and clear it in one step.
- [Section](components/section.md): A page block without a border, named by its title; the title and its actions share one row.
- [SegmentedControl](components/segmented-control.md): Enter one value from a small set of visible segments.
- [Select](components/select.md): Choose one value from a collapsible set of options.
- [Separator](components/separator.md): Express a boundary between content groups as a semantic separator or decorative line.
- [SeverityMark](components/severity-mark.md): An ordered level shown as a number of filled cells, named by the application.
- [Sidebar](components/sidebar.md): Persistent navigation, an icon rail when collapsed, and an expandable sub-level.
- [Skeleton](components/skeleton.md): Hold the place and row count content will take until it arrives.
- [SkipLink](components/skip-link.md): Lets keyboard users bypass repeated navigation and reach the main content.
- [Slider](components/slider.md): Enter a number or an ordered range within explicit bounds.
- [Sparkline](components/sparkline.md): A small line set in a line of text, showing how a reading has recently changed.
- [Stat](components/stat.md): Values, units and explanations supplied independently.
- [StatusDot](components/status-dot.md): A state graphic and its visible name.
- [Steps](components/steps.md): An ordered process with application-owned progress.
- [Switch](components/switch.md): Immediately change the on/off state of a current setting.
- [Table](components/table.md): Native two-dimensional relationships with complete comparison columns.
- [Tabs](components/tabs.md): Different views of one object with panel drafts retained.
- [TagInput](components/tag-input.md): Confirm a string collection while keeping its unconfirmed draft.
- [Textarea](components/textarea.md): Edit multiline notes and messages.
- [ThemeProvider](components/theme-provider.md): Remember the user's choice of light, dark, or system mode for the whole document. ThemeProvider follows system preference changes and applies the resolved mode to <html>. Mount it once at the app root and use useTheme to read or change the mode.
- [TimeField](components/time-field.md): Fill in a time of day alone, segment by segment: hour, minute, second.
- [TimeRangeField](components/time-range-field.md): Fill in a start and an end time of day in one edit boundary, such as opening hours or a shift.
- [Timeline](components/timeline.md): Preserve input order and actual times.
- [Toast](components/toast.md): Report recoverable, non-critical facts while the current work continues.
- [Toc](components/toc.md): A vertical in-page table of contents for moving between sections; the current location deepens its own segment of an existing thin line instead of adding a new shape.
- [Toggle](components/toggle.md): A two-state toggle that holds its pressed fact until toggled again, with a stable name.
- [ToggleGroup](components/toggle-group.md): A shared single or multiple set of toggles whose pressed fact persists.
- [Toolbar](components/toolbar.md): Actual groups, arrow-key focus and operable actions.
- [Tooltip](components/tooltip.md): Read shortcuts, formats and brief context on hover or focus.
- [Tour](components/tour.md): A non-modal, step-by-step guide that points at page elements one after another, with an optional spotlight.
- [Transfer](components/transfer.md): Move items between an available list and a selected list; the value is the keys on the selected side.
- [Tree](components/tree.md): Hierarchy, expansion, focus, independent single selection, and an optional cascading checkable mode for stable nodes.
- [TreeSelect](components/tree-select.md): Choose one node, or check several leaves, on a tree inside a popup.
- [Typography](components/typography.md): Headings, body copy, supporting text and numbers use the existing text steps. Semantics and visual size are independent.
- [Virtual list](components/virtual-list.md): Window fixed or measured-height collections while retaining the reading position and active editing.
- [Workspace](components/workspace.md): An application shell: a sidebar on the page ground beside one work surface, with the header inside the surface and the only scroll container below it.
